defs.def: a piece of special flat glass that reflects images, so that you can see yourself when you look in it 镜子

ex.s: Place a few mirrors around your room so people can see how things look when they try them on.
ex.t: 在房间里放几面镜子，这样人们试穿时能看到效果。

ex.s: History is a mirror reflecting reality．
ex.t: 历史是一面反映现实的镜子。

ex.s: When he was writing his novels, Charles Dickens would act out the parts of the characters, He’d make faces in the mirror, and change his voice for each character.
ex.t: 查尔斯·狄更斯写小说时，会表演角色的部分，对着镜子做鬼脸，并为每个角色变换声音。

ex.s: They’re the little spots of color like throw pillows, mirrors and baskets that most of us use to add visual interest to our rooms.
ex.t: 它们是像抱枕、镜子和篮子那样的小色块，我们大多数人都用它们为房间增添视觉趣味。

ex.s: It is said that it’s a mirror that can tell right from wrong!
ex.t: 据说那是一面能分辨是非的镜子！

ex.s: She turned around and around, enjoying her look in the mirror.
ex.t: 她转了一圈又一圈，欣赏着镜中的自己。

ex.s: Its four main instruments use a 2.4-metre mirror to look deep into space.
ex.t: 它的四个主要仪器使用一面2.4米的镜子来深入观测太空。

ex.s: Cuona Lake is so close to the railway that I want to reach out and touch its pale blue mirror-like surface.
ex.t: 措那湖离铁路如此之近，以至于我伸出手就能碰到它淡蓝色镜子般的湖面。

defs.def: something that shows what sth else is like 写照；反映某种情况的事物
to have features that are similar to sth else and which show what it is like 反映

ex.s: These stages mirror the development of human conceptions of the sea.
ex.t: 这些阶段反映了人类对海洋认知的发展。

ex.s: For better or worse, ALife mirrors the very subject it studies.
ex.t: 无论好坏，ALife反映了它所研究的对象本身。

ex.s: AI mirrors the developments of ALife.
Talk about history and culture EXAMPLE Tourist A: I beg your pardon, but is this the Xuanyuan Mirror?
ex.t: 谈论历史和文化 示例 游客A：对不起打扰一下，请问这是轩辕镜吗？

defs.def: to show the image of sb/sth on the surface of water, glass, etc. 映照；反射
